sloka: इतिउक्तः परुषम् वाक्यम् न्यायवादी विभीषणः ।उत्पपात गदापाणिःचतुर्भिः सह राक्षसैः ॥६-१६-१७॥।।
transliteration: itiuktaḥ paruṣam vākyam nyāyavādī vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।utpapāta gadāpāṇiḥcaturbhiḥ saha rākṣasaiḥ ॥6-16-17॥।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana who was just in his argument rose up, wielding mace in hand accompanied by the four Rakshasas, when Ravana had spoken such harsh words to him.
